scope: source-only; no deployment; no hosted file edited

ledger.compaction: startup + every 600s on begin(); atomic os.replace under flock; offset set to written bytes and inode taken from temp file before post-replace appends so concurrent replica appends after os.replace are replayed; live reservations kept; readers re-open on inode change

dlq.policy: entries tagged writer_error/retry_exhausted/TELEMETRY_REPLAY_DLQ_TAG never aged out; others dropped past retention at load and during normal operation (reject triggers compaction once the injectable-clock elapsed interval, default min(1h, retention), passes) via streamed atomic rewrite
